sections.title: O společnosti

sections.content: Jako mechanik jeřábové techniky budete zajišťovat provozuschopnost zdvihacích zařízení, provádět jejich opravy a poskytovat technickou podporu. Budete zpracovávat analýzy technického stavu strojů, navrhovat preventivní údržbu a podílet se na zvyšování efektivity správy majetku. Součástí práce je také technická spolupráce při objednávkách, účast ve výběrových řízeních a výkon funkce provozního technika zdvihacích zařízení s odpovědností za jejich bezpečný provoz.

Aktivně se podílet na realizaci oprav strojů a zařízení, řídit průběh oprav a poskytovat odbornou technickou podporu
Zpracovávat přehledy a analýzy technického stavu strojů a zařízení a navrhovat postupy preventivní údržby i oprav
Aktivně se účastnit procesů zlepšování a přispívat ke zvyšování efektivity a produktivity v oblasti správy a údržby majetku
Technicky spolupracovat na objednávkovém procesu a podílet se na výběrových řízeních týkajících se údržby a oprav zařízení

Definir e revisar estratégias de manutenção (RCM, FMEA, manutenção baseada em condição, run-to-failure)

Avaliar riscos técnicos associados a mudanças operacionais, apoiando processos de MOC (Management of Change)
Desenvolver estudos técnicos para aumento de disponibilidade, redução de falhas e melhoria da segurança operacional

sections.title: Role Summary
sections.content: Lead the North America customs and import program for Baker Hughes, Industrial Energy Technology (IET). Own day-to-day operations execution, governance, broker performance, and post-entry accuracy. Implement and sustain CBP and Canada's Customs programs. Manage and coach the import team and upskill stakeholders to ensure compliant, efficient cross-border flows.

sections.title: Governance & Compliance
content: Own compliance with U.S. (CBP) and Canada (CBSA) laws and policies across classification, valuation, origin, admissibility, and partner government agency (PGA) requirements
Establish and maintain internal controls that meet "reasonable care" standards, including procedures, work instructions, and periodic testing
Lead recordkeeping controls: U.S. (5 years) and Canada (6 years), with complete audit trails and secure retrieval
Run post-entry processes end to end: Post Summary Corrections (PSC), Reconciliation, duty refunds, prior disclosures, protests, and drawback coordination as needed
Lead and manage internal audits, and CBP trade regulatory audits and verifications

sections.title: Programs & Certifications
content: Implement and sustain CBP CTPAT Security; partner with stakeholders on remediation and continuous improvement
Build readiness and governance for CTPAT Trade Compliance (Trusted Trader modernization), including internal control design, risk assessment, and self-testing
Lead Canada Trusted Trader programs (PIP/CSA): meet Minimum Security Requirements, prepare for validations, and manage action plans
Operationalize Canada's CARM requirements (Commercial Accounting Declarations, RPP, harmonized billing) with the import team and brokers

sections.title: Broker Operations & Performance
content: Customs broker management: SOPs, power of attorney, billing accuracy, performance scorecards, business reviews
Ensure brokers meet regulatory requirements and changes, ACE data quality, and KPI targets
Drive root cause analysis on entry errors and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

sections.title: Tariff Strategy & Trade Programs
content: Cross-functional collaboration with BU's engineering, supply chain, classification and trade-compliance for regulatory compliance
Evaluating and executing duty-savings opportunities: FTA's, Drawback, Tariff-rate quotas, and other strategic areas
Monitoring Section 301/232/IEEPA trade remedies and other tariff actions; advise leaders on impacts and mitigations
Providing tariff impact analysis, scenario modeling, and recommendations for strategic trade decisions
Oversee quota planning and critical shipments; ensure timely and correct filings (ACE, portal, CAD/CARM)

sections.title: Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
content: Managing the NAM import team: set priorities, coach, mentor, and build career paths
Providing clear training for procurement, logistics, finance, and business teams on customs basics and Incoterms
Influencing to drive process adherence and systems adoption across product companies and functions

sections.title: Qualifications
content: Bachelor's degree in International Trade, Supply Chain, Business, or related field
10+ years in U.S./Canada customs or trade compliance, including leadership of broker operations and post-entry
U.S. Licensed Customs Broker strongly preferred; experience with Canadian customs (PIP/CSA, CARM) is a plus
Working knowledge of export controls and sanctions interfaces (screenings/escalations)
Deep knowledge of HTS classification, customs valuation, rules of origin, and partner government agency requirements
Hands-on experience with PSC, Reconciliation, audits/verifications, and internal control frameworks
Working knowledge of ACE (reports/portal) and CBSA CARM; proficiency with ERP (SAP/Oracle) and analytics dashboards

content: First-pass entry accuracy and on-time clearance
PSC/Reconciliation/protest cycle time and accuracy
Audit/verification outcomes and issue-free rates
Broker accuracy, timeliness, and cost-to-serve
FTA claim accuracy and duty savings delivered
Training coverage and policy/process adherence

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: Baker Hughes is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to lead the evolution of our build, test, release, and runtime platforms across mobile and backend services. You will define standards for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and security automation; mentor engineers; and partner with product and security to ship secure, reliable software at scale.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Defining and maintaining the North Star for CI/CD and platform workflows (source control, pipelines, artifact management, environments), emphasizing reliability, repeatability, and developer experience
Standardizing CI/CD using Azure Pipelines; create reusable workflows and accelerate delivery for legacy products CI/CD as well as platform workflows
Leading modernization of build and deploy processes to containers and managed compute (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) where applicable
Embedding DevSecOps by integrating SAST/SCA (e.g., Fortify, Black Duck) and quality gates (SonarQube) into the pipelines to shift security left
Establishing platform architecture principles and guardrails for scalability, security, and operability; document golden paths and reference implementations
Driving Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modular, DRY patterns) and Ansible; promote GitOps workflows for environment provisioning and change control
Defining standards for observability (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana), SLOs, and incident response; partner with teams to implement metrics-first operations
Mentoring DevOps and product team engineers; conduct PR reviews for new components and microservice build scripts; and coach teams on platform CI/CD best practices and secure-by-default delivery

Collaborating with Product Management on roadmap alignment, with Security to codify controls, and with QA/Release to streamline testing and release orchestration (e.g., automated tester notifications)

sections.title: Required Qualifications
content: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field
Minimum of 7–10 years of experience across DevOps/Platform/SRE, including leading CI/CD standardization and modernization initiatives in multi-team environments
Demonstrated achievements improving deployment speed, cost efficiency, and reliability through automation, container platforms, and managed services on AWS
Experience in CI/CD: Azure Pipelines; reusable workflows; build automation; approvals and notifications
Experience in Cloud & IaC: AWS (core services), Terraform (modular patterns), Ansible; Azure Devops based environment provisioning and policy-as-code
Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS); packaging, deployment
Experience in Security & Quality: Fortify, GHAS, Black Duck, SonarQube; SAST/SCA integration and quality gates in CI/CD
Experience in Observability: Prometheus, Grafana; metrics/SLOs, alerting, and runbooks for production readiness
Scripting/OS: Python, Bash; Linux, Windows, macOS (build and runtime contexts)

sections.title: Descripción del Puesto
sections.content: Coordinar la entrega segura, eficiente y optimizada de los servicios de barrenas, asegurando la selección adecuada de productos, el diseño óptimo para cada sección del pozo y el soporte técnico antes, durante y después de la operación, garantizando una perforación eficiente y la satisfacción del cliente.

sections.title: Planificación Técnica y Selección de Barrenas
content: Realizar análisis de pozos offset y diseñar programas de barrenas con base en litología, parámetros de perforación y objetivos del cliente
Seleccionar el tipo de barrena adecuado (PDC, Roller Cone, Hybrid), geometrías, cortadores y configuración del bit
Coordinar recursos, inventarios, reparación, disponibilidad y certificación de barrenas
Integrar el diseño del BHA considerando motores, RSS, estabilizadores y herramientas de control direccional

sections.title: Gestión Operativa
content: Dar soporte técnico en tiempo real sobre desempeño de barrenas, desgaste, ROP y eficiencia mecánica
Monitorear parámetros clave: WOB, RPM, flujo, diferencial, vibraciones, stick-slip, whirl, MSE (Mechanical Specific Energy)
Analizar causas de bajo desempeño y emitir recomendaciones para optimización
Asegurar la correcta recuperación, codificación IADC y análisis de desgaste post-run (bit dull grading)

sections.title: Relación con el Cliente
content: Ser el enlace técnico principal con el cliente para temas relacionados con barrenas
Presentar propuestas técnicas, benchmarking, análisis offset, predicciones de ROP y estrategias de perforación
Participar en DWOP, pre-job, post-job y revisiones de desempeño
Brindar soporte para la toma de decisiones en cambios de BHA, parámetros o selección de nuevo diseño

sections.title: Control de Costos, KPIs y Reportes

Asegurar cumplimiento de metas financieras, minimizando NPT y maximizando ROP
Elaborar reportes técnicos detallados incluyendo: Dull grading, Desempeño vs. offset, KPIs (ROP, horas, MSE, vibraciones, secciones perforadas), Lecciones aprendidas y recomendaciones finales

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: The Funding & Strategic Research Engineer plays a pivotal role in driving innovation through strategic use of public funding and collaboration with a global research ecosystem. This position serves as the central point of contact for the execution of funded research projects and the development of competitive proposals. The selected candidate will be responsible for shaping collaborative research initiatives, aligning them with the company's innovation roadmap, and coordinating cross-functional teams—both internal and external—to ensure successful project delivery. Providing relevant reports to project management to ensure the project manager has all the tools to make the right decisions and drive on-time and on-budget project execution
Interacting with the customer to provide schedule updates and explain the current situation, challenges, and opportunities
Adhering to the approved processes and proactively drive the implementation of new initiatives that will lead to fully integrated planning

sections.title: Requirements
content: Bachelor / Master's degree or relevant experience

Ability to quickly understand the risks and opportunities in the schedule and identify and drive appropriate actions
Strong expertise in planning a large project and using the Primavera P6 planning tool
High energy and motivation to deliver, making a difference in the position

Strong leadership and excellent interpersonal skills are required to collaborate with a team of planners and interact with a large panel of individuals who will contribute to the project's performance
Additional knowledge of Oracle MRP is considered a plus

sections.content: Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving the oil and gas sector across more than 120 countries. The Commercial & Sales organization drives growth by building strong customer partnerships, commercializing hydrocarbons, and delivering integrated equipment and service solutions. With a focus on digital transformation and energy transition, the team leverages data-driven insights to optimize sales performance and maximize customer value.

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: Drive the vision and execution of world-class sourcing strategies across a global organization. You'll lead a high-performing team, strengthen supplier relationships, and deliver innovative solutions that create measurable value for Baker Hughes and its customers. In this role, you'll champion leadership development, optimize processes, and spearhead strategic projects that transform sourcing into a competitive advantage.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Defining and improving sourcing strategies at the business level
Leading a global team of sourcing leaders
Working with the broader sourcing organization to develop and implement supply strategies
Managing supplier performance: cost, quality, lead time, OTD, and responsiveness
Innovating thinking: leveraging experience to develop contracts and creative solutions to improve value for our customers and Baker Hughes
Developing processes, KPIs, measurement systems, and related dashboards
Managing projects: influencing all levels of the organization to drive completion of optimization opportunities
Redesigning processes as required
Communicating effectively with other functional areas and influencing peers to meet objectives
Handling work requiring broad-range strategic thinking along with detailed analysis and interpretation

Minimum of 10 additional years of experience in sourcing management
Domain expertise in supplier contracts, negotiation, and process improvement
Proven history of team development and leadership
Strong working knowledge of supply chain, sourcing, materials management, and contract management
Project management expertise with the ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously

sections.content: We are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Engineer to become a part of multinational and high-performance engineering team delivering automation solutions for the Offshore energy sector. This role will focus on both implementing automation solutions for energy sector and supporting development, client relationships and developing project execution strategies.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Participating in design, development and commissioning of automation systems for offshore deployment
Integrating IT and plant automation systems
Defining validation programs and strategies for automation systems
Identifying and managing technical risks across projects portfolio, cooperating with Project Managers on project scopes and schedule
Leading overall compliance and quality of projects
Supporting interfaces with Client / Vendor on project technical requirements
Providing ad-hoc support for fault detection and troubleshooting of control systems operating offshore

Co-operating with multidisciplinary engineering teams (electronics, electrical engineering, hydraulic and systems engineering) to ensure compliance of technical solutions with Client requirement and both company and industrial standards

sections.title: Required Qualifications

Experience with multiple automation system platforms including PLC, DCS, HMI and SCADA systems (preferable solutions from Allen Bradley Control Logix, Beckhoff, Siemens S7, Proficy Cimplicity, AVEVA InTouch, Ignition SCADA)
Proven experience with industrial networks and communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, CAN, as well as with OPC technology and OPC servers in industrial systems
Ability to read and interpret electrical and process and instrumentation drawings
Demonstrate effective organizational, time management and planning skills
Demonstrate a focus on customer service and attention to detail
Willingness to travel internationally (up to 15%) including travelling offshore
Fluent in English on both verbal and written communication

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: The Data Engineering team helps solve our customers' toughest challenges; making flights safer, power cheaper, and oil & gas production safer for people and the environment by leveraging data and analytics. Data Architect will work on the projects in a technical domain as a technical leader and architect in Data & Information. Will be responsible for data handling, data warehouse building and architecture.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Designing and implementing scalable and robust data pipelines to collect, process, and store data from various sources
Developing and maintaining data warehouse and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for data integration and transformation
Optimizing and tuning the performance of data systems to ensure efficient data processing and analysis
Collaborating with product managers and analysts to understand data requirements and implement solutions for data modeling and analysis
Identifying and resolving data quality issues, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Implement and maintain data governance and security measures to protect sensitive data
Monitoring and troubleshooting data infrastructure, perform root cause analysis, and implement necessary fixes

Ensuring the use of state-of-the-art methodologies to carry out job in the most productive and effective way. This may include research activities to identify and introduce new technologies in the field of data acquisition and data analysis

sections.title: Required Qualifications
content: Bachelors in Computer Science or "STEM" Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with a minimum 4 years of experience
Proven experience as a Data Engineer or similar role, working with large-scale data processing and storage systems
Proficiency in SQL and database management systems (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle)
Experience with building complex jobs for building SCD type mappings using ETL tools like Talend, Informatica, etc
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to handle complex data challenges. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in a team environment
Experience in data modeling, data warehousing and ETL principles
Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP, and their data services (e.g., S3, Redshift, BigQuery)

sections.title: Preferred Qualifications
content: Advanced knowledge of distributed computing and parallel processing. Experience with real-time data processing and streaming technologies (e.g., Apache Kafka, Apache Flink)
Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
Certification in relevant technologies or data engineering disciplines

sections.title: About the Program
sections.content: The Baker Hughes Internship is designed to enable students either pursuing a Bachelors' or Masters' degree or recently graduated to gain hands-on work experience as the foundation of their professional lives. Our internships will give you first-hand insights into the processes, systems, and practices that are aligned to ensure customer needs are met through flawless execution and the application of leading-edge technology.

sections.title: The Experience
sections.content: You'll participate in focused training, and team meetings, work on projects, and present your results. During your internship, you will be supported by a buddy and your manager who will ensure you have a valuable learning experience. You can expect to receive coaching and mentoring to enable you to complete assignments and projects to develop your learning and skillset. You will also have the opportunity to become familiar with the Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) and culture of Baker Hughes, as well as our strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Completing internal projects to deliver customer outcomes and identify business improvements
Learning internal software to assist with the completion of projects and tasks
Collaborating with cross-functional teams and interns to interact and network with global business leaders
Applying Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) standards and procedures in all situations to ensure compliance is maintained
Assisting with the day-to-day manufacturing operations, which may include monitoring equipment, overseeing processes, and ensuring production goals are met
Participating in quality control and quality assurance processes, inspecting products for defects, and ensuring they meet industry standards and company specifications
Identifying opportunities for process optimization, efficiency improvements, and cost reduction in manufacturing operations
Collecting and analyzing data related to manufacturing processes, equipment performance, and product quality
Learning and applying principles of lean manufacturing to minimize waste, improve efficiency, and enhance productivity
Preparing reports, work instructions, and process documentation to ensure consistency and adherence to best practices

sections.title: Requirements
content: Be currently enrolled or recently graduated in a Bachelors' or Masters' level degree in Engineering; Industrial Engineering; Supply Chain (HSE, Quality, Manufacturing) or Logistics
Have maintained a GPA grade greater than or equal to 3.0 out of 4.0 or the equivalent in your country
Be fluent in oral and written English and have effective communication skills
Be able to legally work in the country that you are applying in, without company sponsorship or time restriction

sections.content: We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. In this role, we may be able to offer flexible working patterns. Talk to us about your desired working options when you apply.

sections.title: Tendering Design Engineer Intern
sections.content: The tendering department in Baker Hughes Flexible Pipe Systems prepare bids for prospective customers. The group includes separate commercial and technical teams that work closely together. The technical team is made up of Pipe Systems Design Engineers who are responsible for customer engagement, understanding technical requirements, preparation of technical designs, detailed engineering analysis, commercial assessment, department improvement activities and preparation of technical documentation. The role requires collaboration with most areas of the business, and frequent interaction and discussion with our customers. Suits applicants from Engineering, Sciences or Math disciplines.

Liaising with internal stakeholders
Engineering process improvements and development of software and tools

The role will afford exposure to many engineering disciplines and processes within the project engineering business to work with engineers on improvements to existing tools and development of new ones. The role would suit someone who is a self-starter, who is driven to find and propose solutions to problems, and who enjoys the opportunity to own small improvement projects. Our internships will give you first-hand insights into the processes, systems, and practices that are aligned to ensure customer needs are met through flawless execution and the application of leading-edge technology.

sections.title: What You'll Experience
sections.content: You'll participate in focused training, and team meetings, work on projects, and present your results. During your internship, you will be supported by a buddy and your manager who will ensure you have a valuable learning experience. You can expect to receive coaching and mentoring to enable you to complete assignments and projects to develop your learning and skillset. You will also have the opportunity to become familiar with the Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) and culture of Baker Hughes, as well as our strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Completing internal projects to deliver customer outcomes and identify business improvements
Learning internal software to assist with the completion of projects and tasks
Collaborating with cross-functional teams and interns to interact and network with global business leaders
Applying Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) standards and procedures in all situations to ensure compliance is maintained
Assisting engineers or technologists with ongoing projects by conducting research, data analysis, and providing technical support
Participating in the design process, creating drawings or prototypes, and contributing to the development of new products or technologies
Keeping accurate records of experiments, designs, and project-related information, and preparing reports or documentation as needed
Collaborate in software development, coding, or programming tasks with engineers

Working as part of a team and communicating effectively with colleagues, engineers, and supervisors to achieve project goals, and identifying and addressing technical issues or challenges that arise during projects and proposing solutions

sections.title: Requirements
content: Be currently enrolled or recently graduated in a Bachelors' or Masters' level degree in Engineering, Technology, Mechanics, other STEM-related or business-related program
Have maintained a GPA grade greater than or equal to 3.0 out of 4.0 or the equivalent in your country
Be fluent in oral and written English and have effective communication skills
Be able to legally work in the country that you are applying in, without company sponsorship or time restriction

sections.title: Work in a way that works for you
sections.content: We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. In this role, we may be able to offer flexible working patterns. Talk to us about your desired working options when you apply.

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: As a Sand Core Technician Operator, you will provide support for production and manufacturing for our Artificial Lifts operations. This is a plant or shop floor position that will ensure safe and reliable products. You will oversee operational work ensuring pre-job checks and machine set-up are carried out safely. You will take ownership for producing high-quality products from initial production through to verification and completion.

sections.title: About the Team
sections.content: Our Artificial Lift Manufacturing team's primary products are Pump Stages. We manufacture the Heart of Electrical Submersible Pumping (ESP) system, the machined parts of the global Energy Oil & Gas industry. We are the only Baker Hughes Manufacturing Plant in Thailand, based in Ban Bung, Chonburi.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Performing standardized duties and tasks in the setup and operation of casting and molding equipment used to produce or modify parts or products
Filling mold with mixed material or applies material to mold to specified thickness & performing molds parts or products using casting equipment and ensures uniformity
Operating and adjusting controls of heating equipment to melt material or to cure, dry or bake filled molds according to specifications & open mold and remove finished products
Measuring ingredients and mixing molding or casting material or sealing compound, to prescribed consistency according to formula
Assembling, inserting and adjusting wires, tubes, cores, fittings, rods, or patterns into mold, using hand tools and depth gauge
Removing excess material and levels and smoothening mold mixture & loading or stacks filling molds in oven, drier, or curing box, or on storage racks or carts
Reading work order or examining part to determine part or section of product to be produced & selecting size and type of mold according to instructions
Performing other duties as assigned

sections.title: Requirements
content: Diploma with 1 year of relevant experience in casting or production
Basic skills in mathematics and comprehension of weight/volume measurements
Able to applies basic and develops advance skill in procedures, techniques, tools, material and or equipment appropriate to the area of specialization

sections.content: This role is a shift based working pattern, Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm/8:00 pm to 5:00 am

sections.title: About the Program
sections.content: The Baker Hughes Internship is designed to enable students either pursuing a Bachelors' or Masters' degree or recently graduated to gain hands-on work experience as the foundation of their professional lives. Our internships will give you first-hand insights into the processes, systems, and practices that are aligned to ensure customer needs are met through flawless execution and the application of leading-edge technology.

sections.title: What You'll Experience
sections.content: You'll participate in focused training, and team meetings, work on projects, and present your results. During your internship, you will be supported by a buddy and your manager who will ensure you have a valuable learning experience. You can expect to receive coaching and mentoring to enable you to complete assignments and projects to develop your learning and skillset. You will also have the opportunity to become familiar with the Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) and culture of Baker Hughes, as well as our strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Completing internal projects to deliver customer outcomes and identify business improvements
Learning internal software to assist with the completion of projects and tasks
Collaborating with cross-functional teams and interns to interact and network with global business leaders
Applying Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) standards and procedures in all situations to ensure compliance is maintained

content: Be currently enrolled or recently graduated in a Bachelors' or Masters' level degree in Engineering, Technology, Mechanics, other STEM-related or business-related program
Have maintained a GPA grade greater than or equal to 3.0 out of 4.0 or the equivalent in your country
Be fluent in oral and written English and have effective communication skills
Be able to legally work in the country that you are applying in, without company sponsorship or time restriction

Assurer la traçabilité des pièces et valider (visa + date) des gammes
Veiller au respect des temps gamme
Appliquer toutes les instructions ou modes opératoires liés à l'opération d'usinage (qualité, HSE, production)

Réaliser la vérification de votre usinage et l'état globale de la pièce
Former les nouveaux arrivants (apprentis, stagiaires, nouveaux embauchés)

Faciliter le déroulement des audits internes

S'adapter aux aléas techniques du poste

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: This position delivers a technical job program or application design that maximizes our opportunity to meet the job objectives in line with the contract terms and conditions. Working seamlessly together with the Service Delivery Coordinators and other resources across organizational boundaries to ensure all aspects and constraints of the applications are understood and have been considered.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Ensuring compliance with manage the Job Cycle (MtJC) process

Working with the assigned Service Delivery Coordinator/Salesperson to understand the client's well construction or production objectives as well as the commercial terms for Baker Hughes (i.e. outcome based contract, line item contract, etc.)
Performing offset job analysis and product/service specific engineering modelling calculations to understand application hazards and incident potential
Working together with all disciplines and stakeholders to ensure all aspects and constraints of the application and suggested products/services have been considered
Designing a job program, including risk mitigation plans and contingency plans, that can meet the client's objective(s), maximize revenue potential and ensure future job assignments for Baker Hughes

Working with the assigned Service Delivery Coordinator/Salesperson to ensure any risk of not meeting the client's objective is communicated to the client using the appropriate channels/processes for the respective client
Documenting any calculations/simulations/plan revision and/or changes during the project cycles for visibility to dependent teams and audit purposes
Providing on-demand support in accordance with product portfolio or on-call schedule for job execution
Comparing job as-planned versus job as-executed, document any lessons learned and develop recommendations for further improvements to procedures to ensure continuous improvement takes place
Working on Field Incidents related to products/services

Participating in Incident Investigations when required, ensuring the end to end process is considered, (including job planning, preparation, and execution), when determining incident root cause(s) alongside appropriate corrective actions
Ensuring timely incident management to enable fast customer issue resolution and cash collection
Advising on product improvement opportunities for repetitive component/product failures
Providing sales support and product application recommendation. Product line specific responsibilities as applicable
Handling special projects as required

sections.title: Key Responsibilities

The internship duration is 24 weeks starting January 2026 – June 2026. You'll participate in focused training and team meetings, work on projects, and present your results. During your internship, you will be supported by a buddy and your manager who will ensure you have a valuable learning experience.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Assisting in the development of project plans, timelines, and milestones in collaboration with project managers and teams
Maintaining project documentation, including project charters, schedules, budgets, and progress reports
Identifying potential project risks and assisting in developing risk mitigation strategies
Preparing regular project status reports for project managers and stakeholders, highlighting progress, issues, and upcoming milestones
Applying Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) standards and procedures in all situations to ensure compliance is maintained

sections.title: Requirements
content: Currently enrolled in a Bachelors' or Masters' level degree in Engineering, Technology, other STEM-related or business related program
Maintained a GPA grade greater than or equal to 3.0 out of 4.0 or the equivalent in your country
Fluent in oral and written English and have effective communication skills
Able to relocate for the duration of your internship (locations vary)

Applicant must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or temporary resident, and will not need employment sponsorship now or in the future

sections.title: Compensation
sections.content: The hourly rate range for this position is $22-$44

sections.title: Working with Us
sections.content: You will have the opportunity to become familiar with the Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) and culture of Baker Hughes, as well as our strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion. We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. In this role, we may be able to offer flexible working patterns.

sections.content: We are the leader in well construction and production. Our innovative physical and digital solutions improve efficiency, production and maximize reservoir value. With our continuing activity in the North Sea in both cased hole and open hole services we are looking for experienced Wireline Operators to join our team. As a Wireline Field Engineer, you will be fully competent in all aspects of operator duties at the well site and at the shop, can maintain the unit and perform all pre-job duties, well-site operations and post-job duties, as well as training of junior operators.

Supervising the training of less experienced engineers and personnel. Be crew lead engineer on site for wellsite operations
Working onshore in the base to prepare, plan, troubleshoots faults and complete follow-up report before and after wireline assigned jobs
Working with customer representatives and drill crews on location to coordinate operations with the rig or production facility
Advising customer representative in the wireline operations on site, troubleshooting, perform quality control of logs and other wellsite analysis and wireline decision-making processes
Supervising crew and equipment at the Wellsite. Responsible for RA sources and Explosives handling offshore
Maintaining job records and completes necessary paperwork. Communications as required to service delivery coordinator
Determining / developing resolution to an assortment of problems encountered at the wellsite of a moderately complex scope, where analysis of situations or data requires a variety of factors
Performing all required duties and responsibilities safely and as described by Baker Hughes Standard Operating Procedure
Conducting all business activities in accordance with Baker Hughes HSE policies, Legal Compliance requirements and Baker Hughes Core Values

sections.title: About the Company
sections.content: La nostra divisione Industrial & Energy Technology (IET) fornisce prodotti e servizi che ottimizzano la produzione e il trattamento dell'energia. Aiutiamo una vasta gamma di clienti lungo la catena del valore a ridurre i costi operativi e migliorare la produttività.

sections.title: About the Company
sections.content: Chez Thermodyn, filiale du groupe Baker Hughes, basée au Creusot en Bourgogne (71), nous concevons et fabriquons des machines tournantes pour l'industrie de l'énergie. Nous innovons pour rendre l'énergie plus sûre, plus propre et plus efficace pour les personnes et la planète. Nous sommes leader mondial pour la compression intégrée, sans rejet de gaz et nous utilisons les dernières technologies à la pointe (paliers magnétiques, moteur à grande vitesse). Nous servons aussi notre flotte historique qui intègre différents types de compresseurs centrifuges, compresseurs alternatifs et turbines à vapeur.

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: Vous serez intégré(e) au sein de l'équipe de support technique rattachée à la fonction Engineering au service de la flotte Thermodyn (plus de 1000 compresseurs à gaz et turbines à vapeur dans le monde entier, fabricant depuis plus de 100 ans). Le poste est sédentaire avec éventuellement des missions ponctuelles sur sites client. Thermodyn utilise très fréquemment des ensembles moteur/variateur de vitesse électronique moyenne tension, d'une puissance de 500 kW à 20 MW. Thermodyn a en outre une ligne de produit moto-compresseur grande vitesse, basée sur des moteurs haute vitesse à attaque directe et des variateurs pilotant des fréquences de sortie jusqu'à 300-400 Hz.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Répondre techniquement aux équipes chantier (superviseurs mécanicien et/ou ingénieurs de démarrage) et aux clients opérateurs des machines Thermodyn pour tous les domaines liés aux turbomachines en s'appuyant éventuellement sur les experts des bureaux d'études
Anticiper le support : préparer la mise en service des unités et les maintenances de façon proactive
Assurer le suivi de paramètres, assistance et tests à distance pour la flotte connectée
Coordonner les investigations techniques complexe (pilotage d'analyse des causes racines)
Participer activement aux tâches d'amélioration continue et de qualité (création/amélioration de la documentation de chantier et manuel, mise à jour de la documentation après mise en service)
Se développer pour enrichir son expertise avec de nouvelles techniques, méthodes ou savoir-faire

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Demonstrate knowledge of Workday Recruiting and Talent modules and take the lead for driving configuration changes for the Recruiting and Talent modules along with other team members as needed
Collaborate with Workday Recruiting and Talent Product Owners, and business stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective system configurations within the Workday
Recommend the best solution based on the requirements, budget, and time frame; with the flexibility to adapt the scope as additional needs are identified
Work with multiple work streams, integration teams, and business organizations to ensure cross-functional impacts are considered and mitigated
Facilitate effective brainstorming and design sessions; anticipate how potential ideas may play out in the organization and what behaviors it will drive
Stay up-to-date with the latest Workday releases and provide suggestions around use cases accordingly
Follow company defined change control processes to implement the changes and solutions

sections.title: Required Qualifications
content: Bachelor's degree in business management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Finance, or Human Resources
Minimum 2 years of Workday Recruiting and Talent implementation or support experience

sections.title: Preferred Qualifications
content: Workday Recruiting, and Talent Certification is preferred
Experience as a Workday Recruiting and Talent Consultant
Deep knowledge of Talent Acquisition and Talent Management functional processes
Demonstrated knowledge of Business Process configurations, Custom Reports, Calculated Fields EIBs & migration process
Solid understanding & hands‑on experience configuring Workday Talent & Performance, including goals, reviews, succession, talent calibration, and talent profiles

Solid understanding & hands‑on experience configuring Workday Recruiting, including job application process, EA templates via Workday Docs, Job posting templates & job requisition types & processes, candidate lifecycle
Hands-on experience with Workday Peakon configuration including survey design and question configuration is a plus
Strong understanding of Workday HCM foundations and how Talent modules integrate with Core HR, Compensation, Learning, and Recruiting
Basic understanding of Recruiting and Talent integrations
Configuration experience in Core HCM and Security modules is a plus
Self-starter - requires minimal direction to accomplish goals
Strong customer service focus and responsiveness
Strong analytical skills, interpretive and evaluative skills
Flexible with creative problem-solving skills
Strong organizational skills across multiple threads of work streams
Ability to work well with local and global teams
Adheres to timelines
Attention to detail

sections.title: About Baker Hughes
sections.content: Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century.

sections.title: About the Company
sections.content: Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy‑technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future.

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: The Product Delivery Manager takes ownership of the full delivery cycle through the bid phase through execution and delivery to the end user. This key role provides connection between all functions and the project, driving schedule & budget adherence and ensuring the Baker Hughes non-negotiables requirements are met.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Developing and implementing execution plans to drive delivery of products to the project timeline, cost, and quality requirements
Understanding customer contracts, ensuring compliance with contract requirements, and driving the change process to protect project financial interests
Working closely with suppliers, driving performance to the project requirements and to ensure successful execution
Supporting vendor recovery process when project is faced with unplanned supply chain events
Holding regular lessons learned reviews, sharing key lessons and embedding those lessons in the way we work
Managing risk throughout the product delivery cycle, identifying mitigation plans, and escalating risks that need leadership support to mitigate

sections.title: Requirements
content: Bachelors degree
Proven track record of project management
Commercially savvy, with a strong financial acumen
Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills
Able to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Permanent work permit in UK

sections.title: Work Arrangement
sections.content: We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. Flexible working patterns are available. One of our core values as a business is collaboration and, as such, whilst flexible work options are available, we believe there is a great benefit of having our teams co-located in one of our many office in the United Kingdom.

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: You will join a Systems Engineering team defining the next generation of space communication systems supporting Air Force Military Satellite Communications. You will support Systems Engineering & Integration activities in a multidisciplinary and collaborative environment. The Systems Engineer will interface and collaborate with SE&I team members, contractors, government civilians and members of the USSF. The System Engineer will lead and support several working groups responsible for leading technical discussion, resolve and identify risk, requirement gaps, developing briefings, writing and tracking action items, and authoring meeting minutes.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Develop T&E strategy, Test and Evaluation Master Plan, requirement verification and test plans, test objectives, test methodology, and evaluation criteria
Collect, review, analyze, and report T&E data
Support implementation of common Test and Evaluation database for the program
Support T&E reviews, audits, Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), Deficiency Review Boards (DRBs), Materiel Improvement Process Review Boards (MIPRBs), and Technical Interchange Meetings (TIMs)
Procure test equipment and develop test plans to test out candidate software/hardware changes and technology concepts to determine the feasibility of integration
Provide Government leads with accurate, objective, and impartial verification of the compliance status of systems, subsystems, and applications
Provide support to ensure effective capacity planning and reporting to enable the prioritization of testing tasks and focus testing resources on critical priorities
Conduct technical review boards and root cause analysis in government settings
Implement Test tools and DevOps for testing analysis
Develop system-of-systems verification plans and trace verification plans to test events
Develop system integration plans for end-to-end system capability
Collect, analyze, and report on data collected during system-of-systems integration events
Develop and improve procedures and processes and draft internal operating procedures

sections.title: Required Qualifications
content: Ability to obtain DoD Secret clearance
BS degree in one of the following technical disciplines: engineering, physics, chemistry, mathematics, computer science
10+ years demonstrated experience in multi-faceted tests and test project teams, to include oversight of scheduling
7+ years test and evaluation experience with DoD/USAF test processes and documentation
10+ years' experience in systems engineering
3+ years' experience in space systems, which may be the space, ground, or terminal segments
Experience working with military or DoD civilian clients
Strong interpersonal skills, communication (oral and written), and presentation skills
Proficient in Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Powerpoint)

sections.title: Preferred Qualifications
content: MS degree in one of the following technical disciplines: engineering, physics, computer science
3+ years' experience with ground systems, such as terminals and networks
3+ years' experience with military space systems, MILSATCOM, commercial SATCOM, or network engineering
3+ years' experience in writing Test and Evaluation Master Plans (TEMPs) for space systems
Systems engineering certifications, such as CSEP, ESEP, OCSMP

sections.title: Work Environment
content: Location: On-site
Travel Requirements: Minimal
Working Hours: Standard

sections.title: Compensation and Benefits
content: Basic Compensation: $114,000 - $160,000 in California (based on the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity)
401K plan with company match
Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D
Flexible spending account
Disability coverage
Paid time off or flexible work schedule
Professional training and development

sections.title: About the Program
sections.content: The MILSATCOM Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (MSEIT) effort provides leading edge Systems Engineering & Integration (SE&I) for the US Space Force's Space System Center. We support the Space Force's acquisition of state of the art Military Satellite Communications systems, providing global secure, survivable, and protected communications for our nation's warfighters.

sections.title: Program Summary
sections.content: KBR's Global Asset Management (GAM) group provides comprehensive manufacturing and supply chain solutions globally, serving both commercial and government clients. With a wide range of services including Government Property Management, Production Maintenance, and Equipment Tracking, GAM is dedicated to ensuring excellence in every aspect of the supply chain and asset management process.

sections.title: Job Summary
sections.content: In the role of an entry-level Associate Tool and Gauge Technician, your responsibilities include calibrating and adjusting gauges to adhere to the standards set by manufacturing, assembly, and test departments. You are also responsible for managing electronic inventory records through SAP or similar systems, as well as maintaining accurate calibration records for all gauges issued, returned, or serviced by internal departments and external vendors.

sections.title: Roles and Responsibilities
content: Ability to use gauge blocks, horizontal trimos and other gauge setting devices
Handle the receiving, handling, storing, issuing and delivery of perishable tooling, fixtures, gages, shop supplies, and safety items (PPE)
Ability to take direction and work in a team environment engaging with both internal and external associates
Frequent heavy lifting and standing for prolonged standing

sections.title: Basic Qualifications
content: Must be a U.S. Citizen
High School Diploma or equivalent

sections.title: Preferred Qualifications
content: Knowledge with SAP, Indy Soft
Proficiency in Microsoft Office
Knowledge with Compounds: paint, chemicals
Proficiency in gage setting, perishable cutting tools, grinding wheels, fixtures, and abrasive products
Forklift certification, or capability to acquire one

sections.title: KBR Benefits
sections.content: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: KBR's National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. We are looking for a SME Software Developer who shall apply the principles, theories, and methods of computer science and information technology.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Plan, prioritize and organize software development related tasks for the development team
Manage customer relationships to ensure satisfaction
Consult with client to develop formal user requirements
Work with team to conceptualize user interface layout and design
Architect, develop, and operate system environments to support data storage, development of new models and tools, and daily CAAG operations
Translate user requirements from a formal requirements document into an software application and/or database design
Develop, test, implement and maintain complex software applications and/or databases
Guides, develops, and maintains databases, custom software, web applications, and new models/tools
Oversee the CAAG's data infrastructure to include FT networks, systems administration, accreditation, and licensing
Manage COTS tools deployment and administration

Manage and coordinate with NRO TT personnel to ensure the CAAG operates in accordance with NRO FT policies including information assurance and coordinating approvals through the risk management framework
Work under minimal technical guidance
Draft technical program documentation, such as end-user operational instructions
Develop and maintain software applications and/or databases, including web applications and user interfaces
Privileged users must possess IA certification in accordance with NRO Directive 50-5 and DoD 8570.01-M

sections.title: Required Qualifications
content: Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI with a polygraph
Education: Master's Degree with 9-14 years. Candidates with a bachelor's degree acceptable with 2 additional years of relevant experience
General Software Experience: Software development and testing
Database Skills: Database development, experience with relational databases and SQL
Software Skills: Java, Python, Groovy, Grails, JSON, XML, HTML, Web applications development
IT Experience: Administer and maintain user accounts and Windows-based computers in a cloud environment
Systems security: FT systems administration and accreditation

sections.title: Work Environment
content: Location: On-Site
Travel Requirements: Minimal 0-20%
Working Hours: Standard

sections.title: About the Role

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: We are seeking an International Space Station (ISS) and Gateway Biomedical Flight Controller (BME) at the NASA Johnson Space Center (JSC) in Houston, TX. In this role, you will support the International Space Station (ISS) as a Biomedical Flight Controller (BME) and the Gateway program as an Integrator. This Gateway BME will split half of their time between the two projects for 36 months, after which the employee and their managements will re-assess the division of support.

sections.title: Role Function
sections.content: The general function of the Biomedical Flight Controller (call-sign: BME) is to ensure astronaut health and safety by providing operational and technical support as representatives of the Human Health & Performance (HH&P) Directorate at NASA Johnson Space Center (JSC). The BME provides this support on console in the Mission Control Center (MCC) for the ISS, as well as off-console through various project assignments, meeting support, and other mission support roles. The BME is the primary Crew Health Care System (CHeCS) representative to the MCC flight control team; CHeCS includes all hardware/software in the CounterMeasures System (CMS), Environmental Health System (EHS), Health Maintenance System (HMS), and private video teleconferencing (for routine medical checkups, remote telemedicine support, and psychological support of family/friends).

sections.title: Gateway Integration Role
sections.content: While not supporting console in MCC, this BME will serve as a Human Health and Performance (HHPC) Integrator for the Gateway program. The position is part of a team of integrators and subject matter experts (SMEs) who work together to ensure Gateway adequately incorporates and implements NASA standards into vehicle/mission design. HHP disciplines include crew health, environmental factors, medical operations, physiology, anthropometry, strength and biomechanics, maintenance and housekeeping, safety, habitability and architecture, information management, and displays and controls. Position may eventually include working console in MCC for Gateway operations.

Monitor biomedical, environmental, and other crew-related data during all mission phases
Perform and manage data/communications uplink and downlink in support of crew health and medical operations
Provide technical support to the crew and flight control team for the Crew Health Care System (CHeCS)

Adhere to the Flight Operations Directorate (FOD) shift schedule for MCC Flight Controllers, which generally runs three (3) 9-hour shifts per 24-hour day. The majority of these shifts will be week-day only. Though it is sometimes required to support MCC shifts as needed on weekends and holidays in support of mission duties
Follow Space Station issues and provide/coordinate medical input when needed. Provide technical expertise to the Flight Surgeon in responding to crew health issues

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: Join the ITEA award winning TRMC BDKM team and be a part of the team responsible for revolutionizing how data analysis is performed across the entire Department of Defense. The successful candidate will be part of the KBR team supporting the Test Resource Management Center's (TRMC) Big Data (BD) and Knowledge Management (KM) Team working on BD and KM systems supporting DoD Test Ranges and various acquisition programs.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Data Driven Analysis: Support customers with insights gained from analyzing DoD Test & Evaluation data. Responsible for enabling the development of data-driven decision analysis products through the innovative application, and promotion, of novel methods from data science, machine learning, and operations research to provide robust and flexible testing and evaluation capabilities to support DoD modernization

Data Mining: Use a variety of data mining and data analysis methods, accessing data stored in a variety of data storage paradigms, developing models using common statistical and machine learning modeling approaches, using and creating custom algorithms, implementing analysis workflows in Python or R, and writing reports and documentation

Analytic Experience: Provide analytic consulting services, supporting analytic workflow and product development and testing, promoting the user adoption of methods and best practices from data science, conducting applied methods projects, and supporting the creation of analysis-ready data. Identify opportunities for process or workflow optimization

Customer-Facing Experience: Be the face of the CHEETAS Team and ensure stakeholders have the analytical tools, data products and reports they need to make insightful recommendations based on data driven analysis

Stakeholder Assistance: Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to identify analytic requirements and analysis questions that can be informed through the aggregation and analysis of large data sets collected during test events or exercises
Communication: Drive decisions through successful communication, in written or presented form, of data-based insights. Communicate effectively at both a programmatic and technical level

Technical Support: Run and operate CHEETAS (and other tools); demonstrate these tools to stakeholders & VIPs; convey analysis results; adapt internally-developed tools, notebooks and reports to meet emerging needs; gather use cases, requirements, gaps and needs from stakeholders and provide that information as feature requests or bug reports to the CHEETAS development team; perform impromptu hands-on training sessions with end users and troubleshoot problems from within closed networks without internet access
Independent Work: Work self-motivated and independently with little supervision / direct tasking. Use a variety of methods and models to test the effectiveness of different courses of action

sections.title: Work Environment
content: Location: Remote

Travel Requirements: This position will require travel of 25% with potential surge to 50% to support end users located at various DoD labs and ranges located across the US. When not supporting a site, this position can work remotely or from a nearby KBR office (if available and desired)
Working Hours: Standard

Experience: Previous experience should include working with end users, gathering requirements and refining/operating data analysis tools or products to meet user needs. Previous experience should include developing and interpreting the results of analytic products with DoD specific data types

Experience generating and presenting reports, visualizations and findings to customers

Ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing with customers and teammates
Ability to speak and present findings in front of large groups

sections.title: About the Role
sections.content: The ESP Reliability Engineer is responsible for improving the reliability, performance, and integrity of all Electrical Submersible Pump (ESP) systems throughout their operating life. The main focus is to extend ESP run life, reduce unplanned failures, and support production goals by applying sound reliability engineering practices and data driven analysis.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Lead and coordinate ESP failure investigations, including Dismantle and Inspection (DIFA) and Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA)
Analyze operating parameters, well histories, and performance trends to identify emerging reliability issues
Maintain and update the ESP failure database, ensuring data integrity, traceability, and proper documentation of all incidents
Review and validate contractor failure reports and warranty cases, ensuring corrective actions are effectively implemented
Provide technical recommendations to enhance ESP system design, installation practices, and operational standards
Develop and maintain reliability dashboards and reports to track KPIs such as MTBF, run life, recurring failure modes, and reliability trends
Analyze ESP failure data and historical performance to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities for reliability improvement
Conduct preliminary assessments of reported anomalies or incidents and recommend further investigation or corrective actions
Review reliability metrics and maintenance reports to provide actionable recommendations to improve ESP life and reduce failures
Advise on reliability risks associated with planned changes or maintenance activities, ensuring alignment with design limits and safety standards
Document findings, lessons learned, and recommendations in formal reliability reports and databases
Provide technical expertise on ESP systems to identify, analyze, and resolve performance deviations or anomalies highlighted through DIFA findings
Support site teams in assessing and managing reliability risks to minimize potential production impacts
Review operational data and DIFA insights to recommend improvements in ESP performance, efficiency, and longevity
Collaborate with Operations and Maintenance teams to ensure ESP systems operate within safe and design parameters
Lead investigations into recurring equipment failures identified through DIFA or operational performance trends, and recommend preventive actions
Contribute to reliability-centered maintenance strategies and continuous improvement efforts based on failure analysis findings

sections.title: Process Safety & Risk Management
content: Support the identification and evaluation of reliability-related risks in ESP systems for ORA and other safety frameworks
Analyze mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic ESP failure modes and assess their potential impact on process safety
Review ESP design changes or modifications to ensure both reliability and process safety implications are addressed
Recommend monitoring, control, and mitigation measures to prevent reliability failures from escalating into safety incidents
Integrate lessons learned from ESP failures into process safety management programs to enhance risk reduction
Maintain documentation of reliability assessments, risk analyses, and failure investigation outcomes for compliance and future reference

sections.title: Continuous Improvement
content: Lead or support Continuous Improvement (CI) initiatives focused on increasing ESP availability, reducing failure rates, and lowering lifecycle costs
Analyze recurring failure trends and recommend design, operational, or process modifications to eliminate root causes
Document and share lessons learned, reliability alerts, and best practices across internal teams and contractors
Evaluate and support adoption of new technologies, predictive maintenance tools, and data analytics to strengthen ESP reliability monitoring

sections.title: Collaboration & Coaching

Act as a central point for sharing reliability insights, failure analyses, and technical recommendations across stakeholders
Facilitate cross-functional discussions to prioritize reliability improvements and ensure consistent implementation of best practices

The program provides education on brain donation to service members, veterans, and their families; registers individuals for the Brain Donation Awareness Registry; and recovers whole specimens to support ongoing research at the Uniformed Services University's Brain Tissue Repository. This is an onsite position, rotating between various partner locations each day. Establish and support regional community partnership and outreach events initiatives to strengthen engagement efforts
Approaching and educating families of potential donors about brain donation at the time of death of their military or veteran family member

Screening donors, registering study participants, and coordinating with local coroners, medical examiners, tissue transport providers, to facilitate brain donation for research
Collaborating with Peer/Family Educators on recruitment activities

Performing this work under general supervision where discretion is required, such as in the homes of military members, veterans, and their family members; in the rooms of patients in healthcare facilities; and in funeral homes

Collaborate with project teams to ensure proper integration of models with other engineering components

Document and report all changes made to the models
Work with project management teams to meet deadlines and project goals

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Attention to detail and ability to manage complex data

content: Leads directs and supervises the F&ES department in delivering professional F&ES to clients and customers within the Area of Responsibility served by KBR F&ES. Prepare consolidated F&ES Departmental Reports
Reviews and validates F&ES training and personnel actions
Reviews and evaluates Performance Work Statement (PWS) requirements as they relate to training requirements and provides recommendations to the Fire Chief
In the absence of the F&ES Chief, represent F&ES by providing reports, briefings, attending meetings, inspections and presentations representing F&ES to KBR, customer(s), and client(s)
Assist the Fire Chief in developing and implementing an overall company long-term strategic plan involving fire protection. Plans, administrators, and supervises the training function
When needed, assumes duties and responsibilities of the Fire Chief, Assistant Chief of Operations, or any other position qualified to perform
Plans a comprehensive program of on-the-job and proficiency training for all fire protection personnel
Coordinate and train all fire personnel to maintain the required certification and recertification standards
May be assigned to fill in for Operations personnel assigned to apparatus crews
Fills in for Assistant Fire Chief-Operations or for Fire Chief when needed and perform other Duties as assigned

Assessing all services provided by F&ES department that are associated with the protection and preservation of life, property and the environment, consistent with KBR approved policies, KBR BOSS (PWS), and in accordance with national recognized standards for safety, personnel, and equipment
Writes routine reports and correspondence using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook software
Provide guidance and input to facilitate resourcing F&ES for success through staffing, training and equipping as required to maintain levels of readiness and response
Recommends administrative personnel actions lAW KBR policies. Reviews and files reports, monthly summaries, and vehicle and personnel rosters

U.S. Citizenship and security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain ONE
Passport book (not passport card) with at least 12 months of remaining validity AND with at least 6 blank visa/stamp pages remaining

sections.title: Job Summary
sections.content: The Tactical Vehicle Mechanic performs in accordance with ability to read and comprehend military Electronic and or Tech Manuals, to include lube orders and FMC (Fully mission capable) + Safety verifications. This includes determining and performing appropriate repair parts required, mechanical maintenance actions and repairs on various tactical vehicles, commercial vehicles, and equipment. The Tactical Vehicle Mechanic mentors and enhances the performance of co-workers and other personnel. This is a NIGHT SHIFT POSITION: 3:30 PM - 12:00 AM Saturday – Wednesday.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Perform FMC (Fully Mission Capable) and safety verifications on heavy and light tactical wheeled vehicles and equipment
Identify required repair parts and conduct mechanical maintenance and repairs in accordance with IETM and TM procedures
Maintain and repair PREPO, Green, and White Fleet vehicles and equipment
Participate in the trades helper apprentice program, including validating apprentice work when applicable
Communicate effectively with customers during off-site FMC and safety verifications during Issue and Regeneration cycles
Generate and maintain both physical and electronic logbooks and records
Participate in on-the-job and cross-training as required
Meet the 95% regulatory and contract individual productivity requirement
Ensure all work is performed correctly the first time, following technical manuals and publications
Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on material handling equipment (e.g., forklifts, cranes, RTCH240/250, transport trucks, and trailers)
Conduct diagnostic tests using measuring devices, instruments, and special tools to identify system failures (mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, cooling)
Operate and test various equipment and systems per applicable procedures
Repair and replace components such as engines, drive trains, and body parts
Prepare and complete logs, records, and NTC Inspection packets
Maintain clean and organized work areas per contract and company housekeeping standards
Perform end-of-shift clean-up no earlier than 15 minutes before shift end unless directed otherwise
Support and participate in KBR's Zero Harm Culture, Continuous Improvement Process (CIP), and QA program
Mentor and assist with on-the-job and cross-training
Comply with all company rules, policies, procedures, and safety/environmental/quality standards
Actively participate in the master driver training program

Mitigate risk by: wearing appropriate PPE, using ground guides, conducting proper PMCS, wearing seat belts, obeying speed limits, properly disposing/storing hazardous materials, using three points of contact, stretching as needed
Maintain accountability and proper care of all property and government-furnished equipment
Conduct daily inventory of assigned tools and equipment
Interact favorably with internal and external customers
Write performance evaluation comments and reports when placed in a control/assignment directive role

sections.title: Required Qualifications
content: Must understand and be able to use technical manuals/IETM and schematic diagrams
Field of Expertise: Mechanical inspection, maintenance and repair of light, medium and heavy tactical/commercial vehicles, and equipment

Must be able to pass a U.S. Government background investigation and obtain base access. Due to this, you must be a U.S. Citizen or a U.S. Green Card holder who has lived within the United States for at least the last 3 years to be eligible for this position
High school diploma or equivalent (GED)

Education in lieu of working experience may be considered under the following conditions: Completion of an Associate's Degree or higher in the Automotive Technology Field from an accredited institution; proof of completion by providing a college graduate certificate and transcripts of course completion. Completed education must have been within the last 5 years

Must have two and one-half (2 ½) years verifiable experience in inspection, repair, and maintenance on military combat/tactical wheeled vehicles and their sub-systems/MKT unit/various trailers/various generators and other equipment, OR Must have two and one-half (2 ½) years verifiable experience in inspection, repair, and maintenance on Civilian semitruck tractors and trailers and heavy-duty construction type equipment is included
Relevant experience must include at least six (6) months experience in the current position except when employees are promoting to a higher rated position
Requires a valid Driver's License and ability to obtain a military operator's permit for required vehicles and equipment
Must be able to meet CMF criteria in accordance with DA PAM 611-21 and AR 601-210 and AR750-1
Must possess valid State Real ID

sections.title: Physical Requirements
content: Must be able to perform work in extreme temperatures, low humidity, rain, and blowing sand and dust
Must be able to lift and carry up to 40 pounds unassisted and team lift up to 50 pounds
Must be able to stand, stoop, crawl, and climb for extended periods, including in confined spaces
Must be free of medical restrictions that prevent the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Must be willing to work uncommon hours, extended hours, nights, weekends, and holidays

sections.title: Preferred Qualifications
content: ASE Certification - Extensive knowledge (ASE and CERTIFICATES of completion -preferred) on power and drive train, brakes, electrical and fuel systems with two and one-half (2 ½) years verifiable maintenance experience (lubrication tasks not included)
Tactical Wheeled Vehicle maintenance experience

sections.content: The principal technical professional supports the F/A-18 engineering Fleet Support Team and supports the daily operations of aircraft maintenance. This role provides direct Subject Matter Expert team support, technical guidance, and program/project coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders to optimize maintenance execution, inspection quality, and overall aircraft readiness.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
content: Serves as the program advisory lead for the F/A-18 Fleet Support Team (FST) Engineering Maintenance Readiness Team (MRT), providing technical expertise for highly time-critical projects or tasks requiring specialized knowledge in technical and modification areas

Supports the SLM Integrated Product Team (IPT) and SLM Program Integrators (PI) in executing SLM analytics, supports internal and site teams overseeing Pre- and Post-SLM inspections, and coordinating corrosion data collection to optimize aircraft modification efficiency
Contributes to the creation of technical requirements for Pre- and Post-Service Life Modifications to improve repair quality, minimize modification costs, and reduce turnaround times

Provides program/project management support to drive completion of the F/A-18 C/D High Flight Hour and E/F Service Life Modification (SLM) programs, ensuring timely and effective team contribution to the F/A-18 aircraft full-service life extension goal of 10,000 flight hours

Coordinates with engineers to provide technical advice and assist with problem resolution, particularly in support of aircraft service life modifications, Life Limited Repairs and inspection processes
Provides oversight, guidance, and coordination across multiple stakeholders to optimize program outcomes, inspection quality, and maintenance efficiency
Assist the government assess the technical sufficiency, quality, and timely delivery of program deliverables
Collaborates with NAVAIR PMA-265, FST Engineering, TYCOM, Depot personnel, and squadron leadership to ensure effective execution of F/A-18 pre- and post-SLM inspections

Assist FST Structure Engineers in the management of the Life Limited Repair Program, ensuring timely completion of inspections that reduced maintenance delays and increased aircraft availability for scheduled operations and deployments
Provides support in the development and refinement of Depot tools (Depot Issue Reporting) to improve data collection and analysis for aircraft repair and upgrade activities
Assists in creating Focus Area Lists (FAL) to identify high-impact areas that drive better planning, reduce repair growth, and enhance overall program efficiency

Advise on acquisition and program management activities, offering guidance to government leadership on challenges related to modification, service life extension, delivery planning, and integration efforts
Contribute technical insights during system program reviews to ensure alignment with program objectives and readiness requirements
Assist in the coordination of aircraft service life event planning and process execution for efficient and effective completion of work and expeditious return to flight status

Ensure teams comply with CNAF 4790.2 series policies and consistently apply IETMs and NAVAIR engineering information, including drawings, publications, and bulletins, to support accurate, high-quality maintenance and modification work across all sites
Ensure currency of all DoD and NAVAIR Data Management policies, procedures, and industry standards
Participate in ongoing efforts to improve operational processes, sharing best practices and supporting initiatives that enhance quality, cost-effectiveness, and team performance
